info.name: Marketplace Microservices
info.description:
Public /api traffic goes through the gateway on :8080 - the only port the platform publishes. The nine routes it serves are spec section 19.

Requests under *Internal* and the /actuator health checks address a service directly, because spec section 6 keeps /internal off the public gateway and there is deliberately no route to it through :8080. Those need the service ports republished:

    docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.direct.yml up

Run **Auth > Register customer** then **Auth > Login** first: login stores accessToken/refreshToken/userId as collection variables, and everything else reads them. **Seller > Register + login seller** does the same for the seller role.

The *Negative cases* folder documents deliberate 401/403 behaviour.
